# LightAway 0.4.1 Beta 6 — Updated Logo

**Opt-in pre-release; not stable or Latest.** This is a branding-only update to the preceding LightAway v0.4.1b5.

## Logo refresh

- Package the newly updated integration logo at `custom_components/lightaway/brand/icon.png`.
- Include the matching image at `docs/LightAway.png`.
- Both files were directly updated by the project owner on 27 November 2026 in commit [f5b2776](https://github.com/derhopp/LightAway/commit/f5b277677d1afa2dfedce5b9a8b5e00e91977e51). The artwork is retained unchanged.

No behavior, algorithms, integrations, configuration, or frontend controls have been changed relative to the preceding beta.

## Installation

Enable pre-releases in Home Assistant Marketplace/HACS, install `v0.4.1b6`, and restart Home Assistant. If the previous icon remains visible, refresh the UI/browser cache. The existing stable release `v0.4.0` remains unchanged.
